dogecoin.text: @Jfeitlin That's what I keep telling my friends they think I am crazy, but when it goes to the moon all the salty people who didn't believe in #dogecoin are going to be upset they missed out on an opportunity.

@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs I think they need to cap #dogecoin. Having an unlimited supply of coins will just slow the coin down. Most people are going to mine a ton of coins hold them then wait for the rise then sell, and then rinse and repeat. That's the only issue in my opinion that needs fixed.
